addins.title: NVIDIA GPU support
addins.description: Installs the NVIDIA driver (nvidia-smi, monitoring, overclocking) and the NVIDIA Container Toolkit so Docker apps can use the GPU. Downloaded from Debian and NVIDIA once, kept on your array, and re-installed automatically at every boot.
